text: In the Verma module $M(\lambda)$, the highest weight vector $v_\lambda$ is characterized by (for all $H \in \mathfrak{h}$ and every positive root $\alpha$):
explanation: The highest weight vector is annihilated by the raising operators ($\mathfrak{n}^+$, i.e. all $e_\alpha$) and is an $\mathfrak{h}$-eigenvector of eigenvalue $\lambda$. The lowering operators $f_\alpha$ generate the rest of $M(\lambda)$, so $f_\alpha\cdot v_\lambda \neq 0$ in general; and $H$ acts by $\lambda(H)$, not $0$.
